integrity: The proof is self-contained from crown-graph distances and the definition of strong resolving partitions; the verifier independently checks small cases and the explicit construction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the minimum number of parts but does not classify all minimum strong resolving partitions.
Exhaustive computation is used only as a finite stress test; the infinite family is proved symbolically.
Literature searches reduce but cannot eliminate the risk of an unindexed equivalent result under different terminology.
title: Strong partition dimension of crown graphs
